shipfit 1.0.0 (npm package "shipfit", dist/index.umd.min.js), a web component that draws an EFT
fitting as the game's fitting window: the hull render in the middle, the modules around it by slot.
Author: Vex Drake (souptheloop). Licence: MIT, as declared in the package's package.json.
Copied unchanged on 2026-10-17 for the Doctrines plugin (self-hosted instead of unpkg.com, so the
doctrines pages depend on no third-party CDN). Item data is bundled in the file (2021); the image
server images.evetech.net is the only runtime dependency.
